description: This file is a header file defining the interface and exported APIs for a SNMP plugin component related to the Advanced Networking Service Container (ANSC) and BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes function declarations for initialization, object support checking, unloading, and memory management.

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with a specified maximum supported version and plugin info handle.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the SNMP plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a check of the plugin's memory usage.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryUsage
methods.description: Reports or tracks memory usage statistics.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryTable
methods.description: Handles memory table related information or tracking.
